name: After § 18
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2027
part_text: 18 a. Rejects the setting-up of Europa Experience spaces, considering them to constitute an unacceptable waste of public funds to the detriment of the real priorities of European citizens; underlines that maintaining high costs for these largely underused infrastructures constitutes inefficient and irresponsible management of budgetary resources; denounces the limited interest in these centres, whose attendance remains marginal, and criticises their use as a propaganda tool aimed at promoting an ever more centralised Union to the detriment of Member State sovereignty; rejects any attempt to extend this costly initiative; calls for the discontinuation of any further investment in such spaces;
